XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Sudden engine shutdown while running, with subsequent smooth restart

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Fuel supply

  • Component: High-pressure fuel pump

  • Fault: Occasionally, the vehicle exhibits poor performance with significant power drops and the engine fault light illuminated.

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system:
  • P253F (Worn engine oil detected)
  • P0016 (Crankshaft position/phase 1, bank 1 – Incorrect ratio)

  • P0234 (Turbocharger boost – High value)
  • P132B (Boost pressure control circuit A – Range/performance mismatch)
  • P053F (Fuel pressure, cold start – Range/performance mismatch)
  • P000A (Intake camshaft position 1, bank 1 - Slow response)
  • Cause: Faulty high-pressure fuel pump resulting in fuel contamination of the engine oil. This situation led to poor lubrication of the turbocharger, causing damage.

• Action: Check the condition of the high-pressure fuel pump and, if necessary, overhaul or replace it. Also check the condition of the turbocharger.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The component is located in the engine compartment, on the driver’s side. The estimated time for the procedure is approximately 30 minutes. It is recommended to check the condition of the engine oil and, if necessary, replace it.
